title: Vault Lesson Candidate v1
description: WBS-60.03. The lesson-candidate contract the roadmap names, verbatim: 'Every candidate includes: observed symptom; context; mistaken action if any; root cause; correction; evidence IDs; affected domain; generalizable Core lesson?; acceptance/reality status.' Field naming beyond that list is this session's own inference, named explicitly in the commit: affected_domain is restricted to the closed domain-tag set vault_domain_tags.py enforces for WBS-60.01 (core, mobile, mdm, brotherds), since a lesson candidate is exactly the kind of record that vocabulary exists to tag; acceptance_status's three-value vocabulary (PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED) is not stated anywhere in the roadmap text, which only asks for 'acceptance/reality status' without naming values. Only the keyword subset scripts/contract_check.py enforces is used here: type, required, properties, enum, const, additionalProperties, matching outcome-contract-v1, mobile-journey-contract-v1, golden-master-contract-v1 and claim-lifecycle-v1. The promotion rule this roadmap section states elsewhere (section 6.7: create lesson candidates only when supported by accepted evidence, repeated failure, a resolved outcome, or an explicit human decision) is a cross-record, cross-cutting policy, not a structural property of one record; scripts/vault_promotion_policy.py (WBS-60.04) enforces it, not this schema.

schema_version.description: Which shape this record follows, so a reader never has to guess.

observed_symptom.description: The roadmap's 'observed symptom': what was actually seen, in the words of the observation, not an interpretation.

context.description: The roadmap's 'context': the situation the symptom occurred in.

mistaken_action.description: The roadmap's 'mistaken action if any'. Null when no mistaken action was involved (a lesson can be WISDOM, not a mistake, per lesson_severity.py's own precedent).

root_cause.description: The roadmap's 'root cause': why the symptom happened, not merely what happened.

correction.description: The roadmap's 'correction': what closes the root cause.

evidence_ids.description: The roadmap's 'evidence IDs'. May be an empty array for a candidate not yet evidenced; scripts/vault_promotion_policy.py (WBS-60.04), not this schema, decides whether an un-evidenced candidate may be promoted.

affected_domain.description: The roadmap's 'affected domain', restricted to the WBS-60.01 domain-tag closed set (this session's inference, named in the commit: the roadmap does not repeat the vocabulary here, but WBS-60.01 already defines the one closed set a domain field in this Vault should draw from).

generalizable_core_lesson.description: The roadmap's 'generalizable Core lesson?' -- WBS-60.05's own question, answered here per candidate: does this lesson represent a reusable Core failure mode.

acceptance_status.description: The roadmap's 'acceptance/reality status'. Vocabulary is this session's own inference (named in the commit): the roadmap does not name the values, only the concept.
